description: The summit is expected to bring together more than 1,800 exhibitors, 25,000 delegates, 1,000 startups from more than 75 countries.
body_lead: Karnataka launches Bengaluru Tech Summit 2026 with ‘AI & Beyond’ theme, unveils AI University The summit is expected to bring together more than 1,800 exhibitors, 25,000 delegates, 1,000 startups and over 60,000 business visitors from more than 75 countries. Synopsis: The Karnataka government has announced that the 29th Bengaluru Tech Summit 2026 will be held from 17 to 19 November at the Bangalore International Exhibition Centre with the theme ‘AI & Beyond’, bringing together exhibitors, startups and delegates from more than 75 countries.
